question: List all products
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productCode", "productName", "productLine", "productVendor", "quantityInStock", "buyPrice", "MSRP" FROM products ORDER BY "productName";

question: Get all customers
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "customerNumber", "customerName", "contactFirstName", "contactLastName", phone, city, country, "creditLimit" FROM customers ORDER BY "customerName";

question: Show all orders
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "orderNumber", "orderDate", "requiredDate", "shippedDate", status, "customerNumber" FROM orders ORDER BY "orderNumber";

question: List all employees
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "employeeNumber", "firstName", "lastName", email, "jobTitle", "officeCode", "reportsTo" FROM employees ORDER BY "employeeNumber";

question: Get all offices
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "officeCode", city, phone, "addressLine1", "addressLine2", state, country, "postalCode", territory FROM offices ORDER BY "officeCode";

question: Show all product lines
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productLine", "textDescription" FROM productlines ORDER BY "productLine";

question: List all payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "customerNumber", "checkNumber", "paymentDate", amount FROM payments ORDER BY "paymentDate", "customerNumber";

question: Get product names and prices
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productName", "buyPrice", "MSRP" FROM products ORDER BY "productName";

question: Get customer names and cities
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "customerName", city FROM customers ORDER BY "customerName";

question: List employee first and last names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "firstName", "lastName" FROM employees ORDER BY "lastName", "firstName";

question: Get all order dates
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "orderNumber", "orderDate" FROM orders ORDER BY "orderDate", "orderNumber";

question: Show product vendor list
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "productVendor" FROM products ORDER BY "productVendor";

question: Get all product codes
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productCode" FROM products ORDER BY "productCode";

question: List all countries from offices
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM offices ORDER BY country;

question: Show all order statuses
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders ORDER BY status;

question: Get all payment amounts
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "checkNumber", "paymentDate", amount FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC, "paymentDate";

question: List all job titles
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "jobTitle" FROM employees ORDER BY "jobTitle";

question: Get customer phone numbers
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "customerName", phone FROM customers ORDER BY "customerName";

question: Show product MSRP values
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productName", "MSRP" FROM products ORDER BY "MSRP" DESC, "productName";

question: List order numbers
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "orderNumber" FROM orders ORDER BY "orderNumber";

question: Get orders with customer names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o."orderNumber", o."orderDate", o.status, c."customerName" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber" ORDER BY o."orderNumber";

question: Get employees with office city
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e."employeeNumber", e."firstName", e."lastName", e."jobTitle", o.city AS office_city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e."officeCode" = o."officeCode" ORDER BY e."employeeNumber";

question: Get payments with customer names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p."checkNumber", p."paymentDate", p.amount, c."customerName" FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber" ORDER BY p."paymentDate", p."checkNumber";

question: Get order details with product names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT od."orderNumber", od."productCode", p."productName", od."quantityOrdered", od."priceEach" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode" ORDER BY od."orderNumber", od."orderLineNumber";

question: Get products with product line description
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p."productCode", p."productName", p."productLine", pl."textDescription" FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p."productLine" = pl."productLine" ORDER BY p."productName";

question: Get customers with sales rep names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c."customerNumber", c."customerName", e."firstName" || ' ' || e."lastName" AS sales_rep_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN employees e ON c."salesRepEmployeeNumber" = e."employeeNumber" ORDER BY c."customerName";

question: Get orders with customer city
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o."orderNumber", o."orderDate", o.status, c.city AS customer_city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber" ORDER BY o."orderNumber";

question: Get employees and their manager
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e."employeeNumber", e."firstName" || ' ' || e."lastName" AS employee_name, m."firstName" || ' ' || m."lastName" AS manager_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e."reportsTo" = m."employeeNumber" ORDER BY e."employeeNumber";

question: Get orderdetails with product vendor
ground_truth_sql: SELECT od."orderNumber", od."productCode", p."productVendor", od."quantityOrdered", od."priceEach" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode" ORDER BY od."orderNumber", od."orderLineNumber";

question: Get payments with customer country
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p."checkNumber", p."paymentDate", p.amount, c.country AS customer_country FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber" ORDER BY p."paymentDate", p."checkNumber";

question: Count customers per country
ground_truth_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country;

question: Total payments per customer
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c."customerNumber", c."customerName", ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_payments FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c."customerNumber" = p."customerNumber" GROUP BY c."customerNumber", c."customerName" ORDER BY total_payments DESC, c."customerName";

question: Number of orders per status
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC, status;

question: Products per product line
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productLine", COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY "productLine" ORDER BY product_count DESC, "productLine";

question: Employees per office
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o."officeCode", o.city, COUNT(e."employeeNumber") AS employee_count FROM offices o LEFT JOIN employees e ON o."officeCode" = e."officeCode" GROUP BY o."officeCode", o.city ORDER BY employee_count DESC, o."officeCode";

question: Total stock per product vendor
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productVendor", SUM("quantityInStock") AS total_stock FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor" ORDER BY total_stock DESC, "productVendor";

question: Average buy price per product line
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productLine", ROUND(AVG("buyPrice"), 2) AS average_buy_price FROM products GROUP BY "productLine" ORDER BY average_buy_price DESC, "productLine";

question: Orders per customer
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c."customerNumber", c."customerName", COUNT(o."orderNumber") AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c."customerNumber" = o."customerNumber" GROUP BY c."customerNumber", c."customerName" ORDER BY order_count DESC, c."customerName";

question: Max MSRP per product line
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productLine", MAX("MSRP") AS max_msrp FROM products GROUP BY "productLine" ORDER BY max_msrp DESC, "productLine";

question: Min buy price per vendor
ground_truth_sql: SELECT "productVendor", MIN("buyPrice") AS min_buy_price FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor" ORDER BY min_buy_price ASC, "productVendor";

question: Total number of customers
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers;

question: Total number of products
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM products;

question: Total revenue from payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM payments;

question: Average product price
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("buyPrice"), 2) AS average_product_price FROM products;

question: Max payment amount
ground_truth_sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_payment_amount FROM payments;

question: Min payment amount
ground_truth_sql: SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_payment_amount FROM payments;

question: Count total orders
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

question: Total quantity in stock
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM("quantityInStock") AS total_quantity_in_stock FROM products;

question: Average MSRP
ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("MSRP"), 2) AS average_msrp FROM products;

question: Number of employees
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_employees FROM employees;
